name: אינטגרל מסוים בשברים חלקיים – גורמים (x+a)(x+b) (באנגלית)
questiontext:
By expressing the integrand as the sum of its partial fractions, find the following definite integral:

\[ \int^{{CT:0}}_{{CT:1}} {{CT:2}} d{{CT:3}}. \]

[[input:ans1]]
[[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
Outline: Find an antiderivative \(F\) of the integrand with partial fractions (decomposition, coefficients, term-by-term integration), then evaluate \(F\) at the limits.
Step 1 — The form of the decomposition
In order to calculate

\[ \int {{CT:2}} d{{CT:3}} \]

we need to express

\[ {{CT:2}} \]

as the sum of its partial fractions.
Partial fractions: \( \frac{p(x)}{(x-a)(x-b)}=\frac{A}{x-a}+\frac{B}{x-b} \); a repeated factor \( (x-a)^2 \) gives \( \frac{A}{x-a}+\frac{B}{(x-a)^2} \); an irreducible \( x^2+bx+c \) gives \( \frac{Ax+B}{x^2+bx+c} \)

\[ \begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle {{CT:2}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:4}} \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:5}}{{CT:6}} + {{CT:7}}{{CT:8}} \end{array} \]

Step 2 — Finding the coefficients
By multiplying both sides by \({{CT:9}}\) we get

\[ \begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle {{CT:10}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:11}}+{{CT:12}} \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:13}} \end{array} \]

Equating coefficients we get a system of equations that can be solved to get \(A = {{CT:14}}\) and \(B = {{CT:15}}\). So,

\[ {{CT:2}} = {{CT:16}} \]

Step 3 — An antiderivative
Hence,

\[ \begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle \int {{CT:2}} d{{CT:3}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle \int {{CT:16}} d{{CT:3}} \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:14}} \int {{CT:6}} d{{CT:3}} + {{CT:15}} \int {{CT:8}} d{{CT:3}} \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:17}} + {{CT:18}} +c \end{array} \]

Step 4 — Substituting the limits
Recall that if

\[ \int f(x) dx = F(x) \]

then

\[ \int^a_b f(x) dx = F(a) - F(b). \]

Then,

\[ \begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle \int^{{CT:0}}_{{CT:1}} {{CT:2}} d{{CT:3}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle F({{CT:0}}) - F({{CT:1}}) \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:19}} - [{{CT:20}}] \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:21}} \end{array} \]
